title: Otis Project Management
summary: This note details the owner's experience in project management at Otis Elevator Company, including managing a significant portfolio and adapting to sudden staffing challenges. It covers responsibilities such as stakeholder coordination, risk management at scale, and technical problem-solving.

key_points.text: Managed a $47M portfolio of 50+ new construction elevator projects simultaneously
Inherited 15+ additional projects on top of the existing portfolio
Reached out to senior PMs and scheduled weekly office hours
Prioritized the most critical deadlines and which customers needed the most attention
Coordinated installations and aligned multiple stakeholders on every project
